auth.signInIntro: Sign in with your mobile number. We'll text you a one-time code, and if you're new, verifying it creates your account.
auth.phoneHint: SMS codes work with Indian mobile numbers.
auth.smsNote: We'll text you a 6-digit code. Standard SMS rates may apply.
auth.sessionExpired: You were signed out. Sign in again to continue.

errors.invalid_destination: Check the number and try again.
errors.unsupported_country: SMS codes work with Indian mobile numbers.
errors.too_many_requests: You've asked for several codes. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts from this device. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.codes_unavailable: Sign-in codes are unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.delivery_unavailable: We couldn't send a code right now. Try again later.
errors.invalid_code: That code isn't right. Check it and try again.
errors.code_expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many incorrect codes. Request a new one.
errors.offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: This is taking too long. Check your connection and try again.

driver.loadErrorMessage: Check your connection and try again.
driver.applyIntro: Tell us who you are and what you ride. OnePondy checks every application before a driver can go on duty.
driver.nameHint: As it appears on your driving licence.
driver.licenceHint: Each licence can be used on one account.
driver.documentsNote: Uploading photos of your documents isn't part of the app yet. Have your licence and registration ready in case OnePondy asks to see them.
driver.reviewWarning: Saving changes sends your details for review again, and you'll be off duty until they're approved.

validation.name: Enter your full name, 2 to 100 characters.
validation.vehicleNumber: Enter the registration number, 4 to 12 letters and digits.
validation.licenceNumber: Enter the licence number, 8 to 20 letters and digits.

errors.driver_changed: Your details changed on another device. We've loaded the latest, so check them and try again.
errors.driver_locked: Your account is suspended, so details can't be changed. Contact OnePondy support.
errors.driver_licence_in_use: That licence number can't be used. If you think this is a mistake, contact OnePondy support.
errors.driver_not_approved: You can go on duty once OnePondy has approved your application.
errors.driver_not_applied: Apply to deliver with OnePondy first.
errors.driver_invalid_transition: That isn't possible right now. Refresh and try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: This is taking too long. Check your connection and try again.

home.pendingMessage: OnePondy is reviewing your application. You can go on duty once it's approved. Check back here for the result.
home.suspendedMessage: Your driver account is suspended: {{reason}} Contact OnePondy support.
home.dutyExplainer: While you're on duty, OnePondy can offer you deliveries. Your location isn't collected now; it's used only during a delivery.
home.noJobsOnMessage: Delivery offers will appear here while you're on duty.
home.noJobsOffMessage: Go on duty to be offered deliveries.
